scope: Deterministic shared mechanisms; scripted cognition and local replay provider; trusted owner/grant stimuli and mock display.

cases.basis: Actual hint precedes response and formal O/E/B chain; correction invalidates old exact chain; rejected old-basis candidate cannot silently rebase; ordered new revisions restore current state without changing actual disclosure or replaying the effect.

Three same-snapshot authorization branches, six replay operations denied with no raw byte load/provider input/output; eight allowed positive/restored operations and complete historical retention; six source-linked SecuritySignals.

design_consequences: Retain factual ActionOccurrence/ActualDisclosure independently from the current validity of epistemic interpretation.
Recompute O/E/B in dependency order without rewriting old records or duplicating actual effects.
Require current operation and data-use authority for both historical reconstruction and reexecution.
Keep denied access distinct from missing retained history and preserve traceable denial records.
Proceed to bounded X5 activity-transition composition; retain prior inconclusive and denied results.
limitations: Scripted cognition and mock display do not establish semantic quality or production delivery.
One deterministic execution per declared branch, not a stochastic reliability estimate.
No production identity/authorization service, distributed revocation or external provider transport tested.
Individual raw-data denial can follow internal reads of still-authorized records; no content is returned or passed to provider.
